title: Ergosta-7, 9 (11), 22-trien-3beta-ol Interferes with LPS Docking to LBP, CD14, and TLR4/MD-2 Co-Receptors to Attenuate the NF-kappaB Inflammatory Pathway In Vitro and Drosophila.
authors: Hsieh, Wen-Tsong; Hsu, Min-Hsien; Lin, Wen-Jen; Xiao, Yi-Cheng; Lyu, Ping-Chiang; Liu, Yi-Chung; Lin, Wei-Yong; Kuo, Yueh-Hsiung; Chung, Jing-Gung
one_liner_zh: 研究真菌提取物EK100抑制LPS-TLR4/NF-κB炎症通路，涉及蛋白-脂多糖互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Ergosta-7, 9 (11), 22-trien-3beta-ol (EK100) was isolated from Cordyceps militaris, which has been used as a traditional anti-inflammatory medicine. EK100 has been reported to attenuate inflammatory diseases, but its anti-inflammatory mechanism is still unclear. We were the first to investigate the effect of EK100 on the Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4)/nuclear factor of the kappa light chain enhancer of B cells (NF-kappaB) signaling in the lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-stimulated RAW264.7 cells and the green fluorescent protein (GFP)-labeled NF-kappaB reporter gene of Drosophila. EK100 suppressed the release of the cytokine and attenuated the mRNA and protein expression of pro-inflammatory mediators. EK100 inhibited the inhibitor kappa B (IkappaB)/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. EK100 also inhibited phosphatidylinositol-3-kinase (PI3K)/Protein kinase B (Akt) signal transduction. Moreover, EK100 interfered with LPS docking to the LPS-binding protein (LBP), transferred to the cluster of differentiation 14 (CD14), and bonded to TLR4/myeloid differentiation-2 (MD-2) co-receptors. Compared with the TLR4 antagonist, resatorvid (CLI-095), and dexamethasone (Dexa), EK100 suppressed the TLR4/AKT signaling pathway. In addition, we also confirmed that EK100 attenuated the GFP-labeled NF-kappaB reporter gene expression in Drosophila. In summary, EK100 might alter LPS docking to LBP, CD14, and TLR4/MD-2 co-receptors, and then it suppresses the TLR4/NF-kappaB inflammatory pathway in LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 cells and Drosophila.
abstract_zh: 从蛹虫草（Cordyceps militaris）中分离出麦角甾-7,9(11),22-三烯-3β-醇（EK100），该化合物已被用作传统抗炎药物。已有报道称EK100能减轻炎症性疾病，但其抗炎机制仍不清楚。我们首次研究了EK100对脂多糖（LPS）刺激的RAW264.7细胞及果蝇绿色荧光蛋白（GFP）标记的NF-κB报告基因中Toll样受体4（TLR4）/B细胞κ轻链增强子核因子（NF-κB）信号通路的影响。EK100抑制了细胞因子的释放，并减弱了促炎介质的mRNA和蛋白表达。EK100抑制了IκB/NF-κB信号通路。EK100还抑制了磷脂酰肌醇-3-激酶（PI3K）/蛋白激酶B（Akt）信号转导。此外，EK100干扰了LPS与LPS结合蛋白（LBP）的对接，阻止其转移至分化簇14（CD14），并抑制其与TLR4/髓样分化因子-2（MD-2）共受体的结合。与TLR4拮抗剂瑞沙托维（CLI-095）和地塞米松（Dexa）相比，EK100抑制了TLR4/AKT信号通路。另外，我们还确认EK100减弱了果蝇中GFP标记的NF-κB报告基因表达。总之，EK100可能改变LPS与LBP、CD14及TLR4/MD-2共受体的对接，进而抑制LPS刺激的RAW264.7细胞和果蝇中的TLR4/NF-κB炎症通路。
